latest.title: Broadcom delivers strong earnings view as CEO touts growth with AI labs
latest.description: Broadcom gave a disappointing revenue forecast for the current quarter but provided robust earnings guidance for fiscal 2028.

latest.title: NBA suspends Clippers owner Ballmer for one year in Kawhi Leonard salary cap probe
latest.description: The NBA also fined the Los Angeles Clippers $30 million and said the team will forfeit five first-round picks, one in each year in drafts starting in 2029.

latest.title: Japan’s Remixpoint Dumps Ethereum, XRP in Shift to Bitcoin-Only Treasury
latest.description: The Japanese company booked a ¥117.8 million profit after selling its ETH, SOL, XRP and DOGE, leaving roughly 1,506 BTC as its only cryptocurrency holding.

latest.title: US officials work with CrowdStrike to fight malware behind crypto theft
latest.description: Federal authorities and private-sector partners were part of an operation to disrupt malware that redirected about $150,000 in crypto over the last eight years.

latest.title: DOJ says Hamas crypto seizures reached $560,000 as FBI took over fundraising sites
latest.description: FBI agents took control of domains and servers, specifically Alqassam.ps, to intercept donations and prevent further fundraising for the Al-Qassam Brigades.

latest.title: Travel industry presses Trump to target 100 million international visitors in Oval Office meeting
latest.description: Trump’s meeting with travel executives comes after a World Cup that showcased his unusually close relationship with FIFA President Gianni Infantino.

latest.title: New Jersey asks the Supreme Court to take on prediction markets
latest.description: The petition comes after a key ruling from the 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals on sports-event contracts.

latest.title: Trump floats renaming Strait of Hormuz the 'Trump Strait'
latest.description: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that more than 17 million barrels of oil transited the strait on Monday, a wartime record.

latest.title: Coinbase launches regulated crypto derivatives in Canada
latest.description: Coinbase is offering eligible Canadian traders perpetual and dated futures with up to 10x leverage as major US trading platforms expand their crypto presence in Canada.

latest.title: Top Pentagon AI Official Sold Millions in Perplexity Stock, Disclosures Show
latest.description: Emil Michael's latest financial filings show a summer exit from Perplexity, months after a January sale of xAI stock that reportedly netted him up to $24 million.

latest.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
latest.description: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

latest.description: The 10-year Treasury note yield reached a fresh multiyear high on Wednesday as inflation and debt concerns pressured global government borrowing costs.

latest.description: The bank-led consortium wants a U.S. dollar token live by the first half of 2027, with a euro version queued up next.

latest.description: Uber is cutting small teams by nearly half and allowing about 1% of its workforce to continue working remotely.
